metadata.description: A Claude Code plugin marketplace from Inference — marketing plugins for the AI rebuild.

plugins.name: newsroom
plugins.description: Six-role newsroom pipeline that takes a rough concept to a publishable, fact-checked draft. Each role runs as an isolated subagent to prevent context convergence.

plugins.name: debate-room
plugins.description: Convene a room of opinionated expert personas to stress-test a question. Each persona is briefed as an independent subagent to prevent convergence, then the orchestrator maps tensions and synthesises a multi-viewpoint answer.

plugins.name: relay-loop
plugins.description: Run an issue from rough idea to merge-ready PR through a disciplined, human-gated agent loop — spec, build, independent review, fix rounds, and a closing wrap that verifies the work landed. Each pass in a fresh context. The rigour of a well-run engineering team without the headcount.

plugins.name: gtm
plugins.description: Go-to-market and marketing strategy skills: positioning, messaging, ICP, growth models and bets, channel maps, ABM, pricing, naming, brand, selling systems and more. Each skill turns a piece of marketing practice into a repeatable workflow.

plugins.name: agentops
plugins.description: Skills for building and running an agent setup: deciding whether a need is a skill or an agent and designing it, handing context between sessions, and checking a thread is safe to close.
